Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
faqs: Do you offer free in-home estimates
Yes. We can visit your home in San Diego County, look over your ducts, HVAC, or dryer vent, and give a clear written quote before any work starts. Call {{phone}} or book online.
How fast can you schedule service
Many jobs can be set for the same day or the next day. We offer morning and afternoon arrival windows. Call if you need urgent help with no heat, no cooling, or a blocked dryer vent.
What areas do you serve

We help homeowners across San Diego including Ocean Beach, Balboa Park, Mira Mesa, Clairemont, Carmel Valley, Rancho Bernardo, Rancho Peñasquitos, Scripps Ranch, La Jolla Shores, Pacific Beach, North Park, and Hillcrest. Nearby neighborhoods are covered too.
How often should air ducts be cleaned
Most homes do well with service every 3 to 5 years. Homes with pets, allergies, remodeling dust, or smoke may need it sooner.
What happens during an air duct cleaning
We protect floors and vents, place a HEPA vacuum, brush and vacuum each supply and return line, clean the registers, and can sanitize when needed. We tidy up and can share before and after photos.
Do you clean and repair dryer vents
Yes. We clean, repair, and reroute dryer vents when needed. Yearly service helps cut fire risk, speeds up dry times, and can lower energy use.
Can you repair or replace HVAC systems
Yes. We service and install heating and cooling systems. If a replacement makes sense, we can size the right system for your home and provide a written quote.
Are you licensed and insured
Yes.license 1036543 and full insurance. Our techs are trained, friendly, and respectful of your home.
Is the cleaning safe for kids and pets
We use safe methods with strong containment and HEPA filtration to keep dust under control. On request we can use low odor products and sanitize air ducts and vents.
How long does a typical job take and will my home get messy
Most duct cleanings take about 2 to 4 hours for an average home. We cover work areas, keep equipment sealed, and clean the space before we leave.
